text.p: TORONTO, Aug 19 Reuter) - The following are top headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
THE GLOBE AND MAIL: Hydro's labour history tainted: Top brass hobbled by 'appallingly bad' union-management relationship, observers say
-York Region teachers out on strike: Overcrowded classes, fewer staff and lack of space cited as reasons
-Doctors reject two-tiered health care: Medical association decides to pursue more government funding for medicare
-Volcano threatens to empty island: Quakes shake Montserrat
-Environmental protection thinning: As government funding dries up and public interest turns to indifference, the watchdogs are beginning to waste away.
Report on Business Section: Corel ditches Java initiative: Firm had dreamed of denting Microsoft with its new kind of office software
-Toyota plans more work for Ontario plant: 25 percent assembly boost for Cambridge is sign of high hopes for Corolla sales
-Cameco in deal to buy Russian uranium: Group aqcuiring what's salvaged from old nuclear warheads
-Dow rallies after Friday's plummet: Sharp rebound pares TSE 300's retreat
THE FINANCIAL POST: Stocks seesaw back but jitters persist: New York blue chips bounce back and the TSE regains some ground after an early plunge, but economic worries continue
-Eaton's on tightrope in hunt for credit line
